## Academic Focus

Hello, I am Sara L. Thomas.

I am an MSc Statistical Ecology student working on machine learning techniques for identification and categorisation in acoustic spectograms. 

SECR is the final stage of a project I am helping with from collected Gibbon spectograms, occurring after data processing, logistic regression, machine learning with CNNs and a shiny app. 

This website will help you with the R package, SECR (spatially explicit capture-recapture), often used in estimating animal abundances.

Work through the home page step-by-step, to improve understanding about data processing, model validation and the SECR package.
